_notes.purpose: Single source of truth for the DINOv3 + Q-Former geolocalization pipeline. attributes.py is NOT used by this pipeline.
_notes.checkpoint_policy: trainable_qformer_weights_only -- frozen DINOv3 / text-encoder state dicts are NEVER written to disk
_notes.checkpoint_access: facebook/dinov3-* checkpoints are gated on Hugging Face -- request access on each model page, then `huggingface-cli login` locally before training.
_notes.checkpoint_choice_rationale: Ground branch uses the web-pretrained DINOv3 (LVD-1689M, natural images) since ground-level photos are everyday scenes. Satellite branch uses the DINOv3 SAT-493M checkpoint, pretrained directly on 493M Maxar satellite tiles -- a much better feature prior for overhead imagery than a web-pretrained backbone. Both are ViT-L/16 (1024-dim) so the two branches are matched in scale/capacity.
_notes.text_encoder_choice_rationale: Default is T5 (flan-t5-large encoder) rather than SigLIP2, because the actual captions in this dataset are long, multi-sentence GPT-4o-generated scene descriptions (commonly 80-110+ words) that would mostly get truncated by SigLIP2's hard 64-token architectural cap (its text tower's position-embedding table only has 64 slots -- this is not a tunable setting, it's how the model was trained). T5's encoder uses relative position bias with no comparable hard short-context wall, so it comfortably handles these caption lengths. The Query Q-Former -- not the frozen text encoder -- is what learns to fuse text with the ground image, so the text encoder does not need to already be image-aligned (T5 never was, and that's fine here). SigLIP2 remains a supported option below (set text_encoder_type to 'siglip2') for shorter-caption datasets.

experiment.description: Ground(+text) query searches a satellite image via Grounded Query Former + Satellite Region Matcher

_text_encoder_alternatives.t5: google/flan-t5-large (hidden_dim 1024) or google/t5-large (hidden_dim 1024) -- relative position bias, no hard short-context cap. text_max_length below is just a truncation safety margin.
_text_encoder_alternatives.siglip2: google/siglip2-base-patch16-224 (hidden_dim 768) -- the model FORCES max_length=64 whenever text_encoder_type=='siglip2', regardless of data.text_max_length below, since that's a hard architectural limit, not a config knob.

data._image_size_note: Satellite crop is larger (320 -> 20x20=400 patches @ patch16) than ground (224 -> 14x14=196 patches) to give the Patch-MIL stage finer-grained regions to search over.
data._ground_norm_note: Standard ImageNet stats, matching the DINOv3 LVD-1689M (web-pretrained) checkpoint.
data._satellite_norm_note: Official stats for the DINOv3 SAT-493M checkpoint, per facebookresearch/dinov3.
data._text_max_length_note: Truncation safety margin for T5 (no hard cap) -- set comfortably above your longest real captions in tokens, not words. Ignored/overridden to 64 if text_encoder_type is switched to 'siglip2'.

stage_schedule._rule: epoch < stage1_epochs -> stage 1, else stage 2 -- but Stage 2's actual run length is ALWAYS (total_epochs - stage1_epochs), counted from wherever Stage 2 starts, even if Stage 1 overran stage1_epochs (e.g. via --resume-from-stage1 on a later checkpoint).

stage2_region_voting._stage2_batch_size_note: Independent from training.batch_size (Stage 1's). Stage 2's per-step memory is stage2_batch_size * train_candidates_per_query satellite encodes through frozen DINOv3 -- e.g. 16*32=512, vs 150 (Stage 1's batch_size) -- so this is deliberately a separate, usually much smaller, knob.
stage2_region_voting._mining_batch_size_note: No-grad encoding pass only (no backward graph, no optimizer state) -- can usually run much larger than training.batch_size. Falls back to training.batch_size if omitted.

loss._stage2_detective_retrieval_weight_note: Deprecated -- old pooled-embedding Stage 2 contrastive loss replaced by region-voting loss; weight forced to 0.0, kept only for backward-compat with old checkpoints/configs.
loss._stage2_global_retrieval_weight_note: Deprecated -- see stage2_detective_retrieval_weight note. Stage 2 now trains exclusively via RegionVotingLoss (see training.stage2_region_voting).
